articles.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX IPO is four times oversubscribed. A crypto bet tells a more cautious story
articles.snippet: The SPCX perpetual still trades above SpaceX’s $135 offer price, but it has fallen sharply from its May highs as traders mark down the first-day premium.

articles.title: XRP drops 4.5% as heavy selling breaks another support level
articles.snippet: XRP lost the $1.13 area on elevated volume, leaving traders focused on whether the latest selloff marks a final washout or the start of a deeper move toward $1.00.

articles.title: Bitcoin and gold fall together as a rate-hike bet hits every hedge
articles.snippet: The relief rally that lifted crypto off last week's lows is unwinding alongside tech stocks and gold, with traders bracing for a US inflation print and a Warsh Fed that may stay hawkish.

articles.title: Crypto tax bills a work-in-progress as U.S. House lawmakers pose concerns
articles.snippet: The effort to push several tax bills is meant to be bipartisan, but the parties may not be comfortable with all details of the seven bills weighed by the panel.

articles.title: Pending Bank of Japan rate decision may impact Bitcoin price: Should traders prepare?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s average price response to Bank of Japan rate hikes was a 22.5% sell-off. Will BOJ’s upcoming policy decision trigger another BTC price crash?
